a1KitContract.programParts: stages 01/02/05/12/13/14/16 are assembled by tool/make_kit_parts.py from the cut prop sheet, the measured footprint and strips of the completed-house source; no model call composes a stage image
a1KitContract.propLayerFlag: stage manifest layers may set prop:true for permanent furnishings that belong to sarangchae_props, not to the completed-house asset; rendering a stage without them must reproduce the source pixel for pixel (enforced for stages 15 and 16)
a1KitContract.cumulativeFrameLayers: generated frame parts stack (07 beams -> 08 purlins -> 09 rafters -> 10 roof base) so the structural-continuity gate never sees a member the model redrew slightly differently
a1KitContract.postProcessingBakedIntoParts: tone/grain adjustments are baked into a part when it is written and recorded in its sha256; nothing is applied after composition
